title: String of Pearls ATC simulator historical schedule schema
description: One normalized representative-day schedule for a single supported airport

schemaVersion.description: Schedule contract version; only version 1 is defined

airportIcao.description: ICAO identifier of the schedule airport in uppercase

timezone.description: IANA time zone name for the airport's local scheduledTime values
timezone.$comment: The asset validator resolves this value through Intl.DateTimeFormat and fails on unknown zones.

sampleDate.description: Representative day the schedule was sampled from, as a real YYYY-MM-DD calendar date

flights.description: Deterministically ordered flights (by scheduledTime then id) for the representative day

name.description: Human-readable name of the data source

url.description: URL the data was obtained from

license.description: License or usage terms for the data

coverage.description: Honest description of what the data does and does not cover

flight.description: A single scheduled movement at the schedule airport

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the schedule

category.description: Whether the flight arrives at or departs from the schedule airport

scheduledTime.description: Local HH:mm time of the movement

airlineIcao.description: Operating airline ICAO identifier in lowercase

originIcao.description: ICAO identifier of the origin airport in uppercase

destinationIcao.description: ICAO identifier of the destination airport in uppercase

aircraftTypeIcao.description: (Optional) uppercase alphanumeric ICAO aircraft type designator
